prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Desktop tray icon navigation copy on the home intro screen and list layout redesigns for friend selection achieved statistically significant wins.
Split-screen persona selection redesigns, background desktop alerts, and reordering sign-in to after friend selection significantly worsened performance.
Hints, wait time indicators, new screens, and new activity flows showed no clear effect.
Initial predictions were often too optimistic for positive changes, while some negative predictions were overly pessimistic.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -2.3% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, hint: -4.7% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +7.2% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, redesign: -1.3% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: +1.2% over 2 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: -2.4% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +12.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +3.7% over 1 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -9.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -1.5% over 2 test(s)
- home, new_flow: -0.3% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: -4.3% over 2 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +1.0% over 3 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: -4.0% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, redesign: -3.2% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: -9.1% over 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 65.6%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 20.9%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Split Layout Redesign: Redesign the story screen into a split layout to separate background lore from onboarding path options. (why: The choose_path step has a 514-second mean duration and 76.2% conversion; clarifying the intro story improves progression velocity.)
1: [sign_in, layout] Card Layout Redesign of Sign-In Screen: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured card layout highlighting account sign-in options. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% and support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets due to signing into duplicate accounts.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Card Layout Redesign of Upload Photos Screen: Redesign the photo upload step into a card layout with step-by-step guidance components for custom pet generation. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 65.6% and a mean time of 1017s, with support reports of custom pet failures.)
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pet Companion Naming Screen: Insert a dedicated companion naming screen right after pet selection to let users personalize their pet before finalizing adoption. (why: Adding emotional investment during the adoption phase helps address the steep 65.6% adoption funnel bottleneck.)
4: [home, layout] Centered Layout Redesign of Waiting Screen: Switch the waiting screen to a centered layout focusing attention on pet initialization status. (why: The waiting step has a long mean duration of 2336s and 81.3% conversion, requiring clearer visual focus during backend setup.)
5: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Overview Flow on Home Intro: Add an interactive desktop controls guide component to the home intro screen illustrating how to summon, control, and hide the desktop pet. (why: Support logs indicate post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once setup is complete.)
6: [choose_path, incentive] Path Choice Mascot Encouragement Badge: Add an animated mascot encouragement component on the choose path screen. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at the choose_path screen, making early visual engagement critical.)
7: [adoption, hint] Adoption Certificate Confirmation Hint: Add a confirmation hint to the adoption certificate screen assuring users that their companion choice is permanently saved. (why: Adoption step has the highest drop-off rate (34.4% drop-off), so reassuring users reduces hesitation before completion.)
8: [finish, redesign] Card Layout Redesign of Home Intro Screen: Redesign the home intro screen into a structured card layout showcasing desktop integration completion. (why: The final onboarding step has a 70.4% conversion and mean time of 5815s; card structure clarifies completion actions.)
